assay_targets_or_enrichments.ontology_label: Chemical cross-linking coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

acquisition: LC MSn data of digested peptides were collected on Orbitrap Fusion Tribrid (Thermo Scientific) with an on-line NanoLC system and analyzed using CID-MS2-MS3 strategy
raw data was analyzed by Proteome Discoverer 2.2 Xlink (ThermoScientific), under DSSO MS2-MS3 mode
enrichment: RP02 and 028 antibodies were crosslinked with hCD38-ECD using CID-cleavable crosslinker DSSO
Chemical cross-linking coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics
workflow_hints: The XlinkX detect program (Thermo Scientific) was used to search MS2 data and identify the list of putative DSSO-interlinked products

Protein N-terminal acetylation, methionine oxidation (15.995 Da), carbamidomethyl cysteine (57.021 Da), hydrolyzed lysine DSSO (176.014 Da), and lysine DSSO Tris (279.078 Da) were selected as variable modifications.

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a chemical cross-linking (XL-MS) study using the DSSO linker to map the epitope of antibodies (RP02, 028) on hCD38-ECD. While not a traditional TPP (Thermal Proteome Profiling) assay, the 'mod_tpp' or similar structural proteomics modifier is often the closest routing for cross-linking in some ontologies, but specifically, this is XL-MS. Acquisition used a CID-MS2-MS3 strategy on an Orbitrap Fusion.

organism: Recombinant human CD38 extracellular domain (amino acids 43–300, hCD38–ECD)
scope: The binary complex of hCD38–ECD with RP02 or 028 was first crosslinked by the collision–induced dissociation (CID)–cleavable crosslinker disuccinimido sulfoxide (DSSO)
DSSO was added to protein complex, linked for 1h, qunched by tris.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis focused on the chemical cross-linking of a purified recombinant human CD38 extracellular domain (hCD38-ECD) with specific scFv antibodies (RP02 and 028). Although the PRIDE metadata mentions 'B cell', the experimental text clarifies that the MS material was a purified binary protein complex, not whole cell lysate.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: Data collected on Orbitrap Fusion Tribrid using LC-MS/MS; however, the primary goal is cross-link identification rather than global quantification.

modifier_candidates_ranked.reason: Explicit use of CID-cleavable crosslinker DSSO and XlinkX software for interlinked peptide identification.

workflow: crosslinked with hCD38-ECD using CID-cleavable crosslinker DSSO
LC MSn data of digested peptides were collected on Orbitrap Fusion Tribrid
XlinkX detect program (Thermo Scientific) was used to search MS2 data
differential: The lysines crosslinked with scFVs were highlighted on the structure of hCD38-ECD (PDB 1yh3) for the epitope analyses.
search_parameters: Protein N-terminal acetylation, methionine oxidation (15.995 Da), carbamidomethyl cysteine (57.021 Da), hydrolyzed lysine DSSO (176.014 Da), and lysine DSSO Tris (279.078 Da) were selected as variable modifications
three defined modifications on uncleaved lysines were chosen, including alkene (C3H2O, 54 Da), sulfenic acid (C3H4O2S, 104 Da), and thiol (C3H2SO, 86 Da)
Chymotrypsin was set as the enzyme with two missed cleavages

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The experiment is a structural proteomics study using chemical cross-linking (CXMS) to map epitopes. It requires a specialized cross-linking pipeline (MS2-MS3) rather than a standard LFQ workflow.
